CHANGE ORDER
CO #: CO-032 Date Issued: 22-Dec-2025
Project Name: Pinecrest Retail Plaza Owner / Client: Cedar Point Holdings LLC
Contractor: Keystone Mechanical Co. Reason: Unforeseen site condition
Description of Change
Conditions found on site differ from the contract documents. Work covers fire-rated door and hardware and upgrade
light fixtures to LED.
Ite m | Description | Qty | Unit | Unit Price | Amount
1 | Fire-rated door and hardware | 6 | EA | $1,502.46 | $9,014.76
2 | Upgrade light fixtures to LED | 71 | EA | $215.07 | $15,269.97
3 | Waterproofing membrane | 484 | SF | $8.33 | $4,031.72
4 | Excavation for unforeseen rock | 150 | CY | $120.41 | $18,061.50
Subtotal $46,377.95
Net Change $46,377.95
Contract Sum Prior to This CO: $4,430,500.00
Contract Sum Including This CO: $4,476,877.95
Change in Contract Time: No change
Status: Approved
Owner Contractor
